about: JRM Holdings develops Dr.Pelo, a Korean brand for professional hair and scalp care. This profile identifies JRM Holdings as the brand owner and Enveco Cosmetic as a separate manufacturer; it does not claim that JRM owns a factory.

The range is presented from the official catalogue. Product names are not treated as proof of a therapeutic effect: anti-hair-loss claims and study results are not published here without separate current-document verification.
